description.value: Brazil Gourmet is a Brazilian pop-up kitchen operating at Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver, serving traditional street foods such as pastel — thin-crust fried pies with assorted fillings — alongside seasoned pork belly and tapioca-based dishes. Now in its fifth year, the business runs on a scheduled basis at the Lonsdale Quay market, making it a cultural detour for cyclists exploring the North Shore waterfront. Pre-ordering is available through the website for those planning ahead.
